s1e04.c01: In a narrow alley, the baby penguin follows a trail of cooking smoke with its nose, while the hamster courier carrying a parcel trails behind.
s1e04.c02: A row of alley restaurants: the neighboring shop has a long line while the tiny restaurant at the end is empty, smoke rising from its chimney.
s1e04.c03: Through the window, a cat chef alone among empty tables grills fish, flipping it lazily.
s1e04.c04: The baby penguin presses its face to the window, drooling, while the hamster tugs its backpack to pull it away.
s1e04.c05: The door opens; the sleepy-eyed cat chef only twitches its ears and points to an empty seat with a ladle.
s1e04.c06: The two sit at the table and the cat chef sets down a plate with a burnt black fish.
s1e04.c07: The baby penguin takes a bite and its fluff stands on end; the hamster secretly stuffs its portion into its cheek.
s1e04.c08: The cat chef looks around the empty tables and its ears droop; the baby penguin peeks toward the kitchen.
s1e04.c09: In the kitchen a polar bear sleeps hugging an igloo fridge; the cat chef struggles to pull out a fish by its tail.
s1e04.c10: A basket of floppy fish with one shiny fish among them; the cat chef picks one at random.
s1e04.c11: The baby penguin sniffs and points its flipper right at the shiny fish.
s1e04.c12: The cat chef grills that fish with a suspicious look; it turns golden and crispy.
s1e04.c13: The cat chef takes a bite; its half-closed eyes pop wide open and its tail stiffens straight up.
s1e04.c14: The cat chef lifts the baby penguin by its backpack handle onto a kitchen chair, the fish-picking spot.
s1e04.c15: Teamwork: the penguin picks fish, the cat grills, and the hamster tries to pocket a plate but gets blocked by a ladle.
s1e04.c16: Chimney smoke spreads through the alley and the noses of the customers in the other line all turn at once.
s1e04.c17: Customers rush in, the empty tables fill up, and a giraffe pokes only its neck through the window.
s1e04.c18: The cat chef cooks keeping rhythm with a ladle, face deadpan but tail swishing happily.
s1e04.c19: The smell wakes the polar bear, who opens the igloo door and offers out a fish.
s1e04.c20: Night: plates are stacked like towers and the three lie sprawled on the floor, exhausted.
s1e04.c21: The cat chef silently hands over two fish skewers wrapped in paper.
s1e04.c22: The hamster shows the footprint stamp on the parcel and shrugs; the baby penguin presses its foot to it.
s1e04.c23: The cat chef points with a ladle at a picture poster on the wall.
s1e04.c24: Close-up of the picture poster: snowflake train, lighthouse beach, ship, iceberg with penguins, three suns and a boat; slow push-in.
s1e04.c25: The baby penguin and the hamster count the suns one by one, their eyes widen, and the pebble in the backpack glows brightly.

s1e05.c01: At a hilltop station at night, a snowflake train puffs steam mixed with snowflakes; the baby penguin and the hamster arrive panting on the platform.
s1e05.c02: At the ticket booth a squirrel clerk takes acorns, stuffs them in its cheeks and hands out leaf tickets; the two at the end of the line have nothing.
s1e05.c03: The baby penguin turns its backpack upside down and shakes out a pebble, a map and a fish skewer; no acorns.
s1e05.c04: Trains wait on both sides of the platform; the baby penguin opens the map and confidently points at the right-hand train.
s1e05.c05: A badger porter loads parcel boxes onto the freight car with a cart; the hamster's eyes sparkle.
s1e05.c06: The hamster points at a big empty box and taps its courier cap; the baby penguin takes a step back.
s1e05.c07: Inside the box, the two sit squeezed together while the pebble glow lights their faces.
s1e05.c08: The porter stamps a snowflake stamp on the box with a thump; two pairs of eyes peek through the handle hole.
s1e05.c09: In the freight car the box lid opens and two heads pop up; a box in the corner wiggles by itself.
s1e05.c10: The snowflake train runs across night fields, snowflakes swirling from its chimney.
s1e05.c11: The two sneak in through the carriage door; a sheep grandma knits and a migratory bird navigator hangs from the ceiling ring.
s1e05.c12: The far door opens and a raccoon conductor enters clicking a ticket punch; passengers hold out tickets.
s1e05.c13: Hiding under a seat, the red backpack sticks out and the conductor's feet stop right in front of it.
s1e05.c14: As the conductor bends down, the sheep grandma holds out her ticket and the two tiptoe away.
s1e05.c15: Hiding inside the sheep grandma's big ball of yarn, only faces and a cap show while she keeps knitting innocently.
s1e05.c16: The conductor peers suspiciously at the yarn ball, clicking the punch.
s1e05.c17: A hedgehog snack cart rolls by with skewers, apples and donuts on its spikes, a trail of smell rising.
s1e05.c18: The baby penguin slides out of the yarn following the smell; the hamster grabs the backpack and the yarn unravels.
s1e05.c19: The baby penguin covered in yarn locks eyes with the conductor.
s1e05.c20: A chase down the aisle: the two run, the conductor follows, a long trail of yarn behind.
s1e05.c21: At the last carriage door there is nowhere to go and the conductor approaches.
s1e05.c22: The hamster shows the parcel footprint stamp and the baby penguin holds out a fish skewer with trembling flippers.
s1e05.c23: The conductor takes a bite of the skewer and its eyes curve into happy half-moons.
s1e05.c24: The conductor punches a snowflake-shaped hole in the corner of the parcel with a click.
s1e05.c25: The two sit side by side at the window; the bird navigator points toward the back of the train and dawn brightens outside.

s1e06.c01: At a tiny station in the snowy mountains, the raccoon conductor punches one more hole in the parcel and points to the train on the opposite platform; the baby penguin and the hamster courier nod.
s1e06.c02: By the window of the train going the other way, the sea comes into view; the migratory bird navigator hanging from the ceiling points forward, looking pleased.
s1e06.c03: At a seaside station at sunset the baby penguin and the hamster step off the train; orange sky, seagulls, fishing boats and a lighthouse on the hill.
s1e06.c04: On the pier, a picture sign shows a boat under the moon and stars following the lighthouse beam; the hamster traces it with his finger while reading.
s1e06.c05: In the top room of the lighthouse on the hill, a tiny firefly keeper lights the sea with the glow of his tail while on duty, the lens turning the glow into a beam.
s1e06.c06: The baby penguin and the hamster sit side by side at the end of the pier waiting, sharing the last fish skewer half each.
s1e06.c07: The baby penguin turns his head; on a rock in the distance a small crab claw is waving.
s1e06.c08: A baby crab with its claw stuck in a crack in the rocks, eyes full of tears, the rising tide already up to its ankles.
s1e06.c09: Running over, the baby penguin slips on the wet rock and the hamster grabs his backpack just in time.
s1e06.c10: The baby penguin pulls on the stuck claw but it won't come out; the crab only wriggles sideways.
s1e06.c11: The water rises up to their bellies and dark storm clouds roll in from the horizon.
s1e06.c12: As the two push against the rock, a big wave crashes over them; all three are swept along and the claw pops free.
s1e06.c13: The grateful crab tries to come closer for a hug but keeps sliding sideways past the baby penguin.
s1e06.c14: The baby penguin gives the crab a ride on his head; the crab points the way with its claw.
s1e06.c15: The three cross a rocky path between storm clouds and waves; the glowing pebble in the backpack lights their steps.
s1e06.c16: In front of a rock cave, the crab family greets them; the mother crab and siblings clap their claws.
s1e06.c17: The mother crab hugs the baby crab tightly; watching them, the pebble in the baby penguin's backpack glows warmly.
s1e06.c18: The crab family offers a conch shell as a gift; the hamster receives it with both hands.
s1e06.c19: Back at the pier under a pitch-dark sky, a single boat light appears on the horizon; the two jump with joy.
s1e06.c20: At the top of the lighthouse, the hand of the firefly's pocket watch reaches the moon symbol; the firefly yawns.
s1e06.c21: The firefly keeper closes his logbook and packs his lunchbox into his bag.
s1e06.c22: Click: the firefly's tail light switches off and the lighthouse goes dark.
s1e06.c23: On the pier, the light on their faces disappears and the two look up at the dark lighthouse.
s1e06.c24: The firefly hums as he walks past the two on his way home; they reach out their arms but can't reach him.
s1e06.c25: The baby penguin lifts his glowing pebble high above his head while the hamster waves his cap toward the sea.

s1e07.c01: A night pier: the baby penguin sits slumped under the dark lighthouse, the pebble in his hand glowing faintly; the horizon is empty.
s1e07.c02: The hamster courier straightens his cap and pulls three postcards out of his cheek pouch.
s1e07.c03: A pelican mailbox perched on a pier post: the hamster drops in the postcards and the beak pouch catches them, fish visible inside.
s1e07.c04: The pelican flies up into the night sky while the two watch it go.
s1e07.c05: As the moon crosses the sky, the two sit back to back waiting; the baby penguin nods off.
s1e07.c06: Two headlights on a hill road: a turtle delivery truck comes very slowly, and a seagull on foot walks past and overtakes it.
s1e07.c07: The truck's back door opens and the cat chef with a fish lunchbox and the raccoon conductor with his ticket punch step out; the baby penguin's eyes go wide.
s1e07.c08: From the rocks, the crab family walks over sideways in a line, the baby crab in front waving its claw.
s1e07.c09: The baby penguin runs into the cat chef's arms; the pebble in his backpack glows bright again.
s1e07.c10: The hamster lays out a battle plan on the ground with shells and stones while everyone sits around it watching.
s1e07.c11: In a reed field on the sand dunes, glass-jar houses hang from branches, all dark; the firefly keeper sleeps inside wearing a sleep mask.
s1e07.c12: The hamster taps on the jar and the raccoon conductor clicks his punch, but the firefly does not wake up.
s1e07.c13: The cat chef opens the lunchbox; the smell of grilled fish drifts into the jar and the firefly's nose twitches.
s1e07.c14: The awakened firefly points at the moon on his pocket watch and shakes his head: it is off-duty time.
s1e07.c15: The raccoon conductor punches a hole in an overtime permit card drawn with a moon and a sun and holds it out.
s1e07.c16: The firefly examines the card, then pulls down his cap; his tail light switches on.
s1e07.c17: The glass-jar houses light up one after another and a crew of fireflies pours out into the night sky.
s1e07.c18: Fireflies line up in a single row over the sea, forming a road of light from the pier to the horizon.
s1e07.c19: At the end of the pier the crab family clicks their claws while the baby penguin holds up a conch shell, and ripples of sound spread over the sea.
s1e07.c20: A giant whale wearing a red firefighter helmet rises from the sea and answers with a tall water spout from its blowhole.
s1e07.c21: The whale rests its tail against the pier; the raccoon conductor punches a third hole in the parcel, turning it into a boarding pass.
s1e07.c22: The cat chef tucks a fish lunchbox into the baby penguin's backpack while the baby crab cries.
s1e07.c23: On the whale's back, the two set off along the road of light over the sea.
s1e07.c24: Friends on the pier wave a ladle, a ticket punch and claws goodbye as the sky brightens behind the village hill.
s1e07.c25: At the end of the road of light, the last boat's lamp appears far away; the two jump with joy, but a wall of storm clouds looms ahead.

s1e08.c01: A stormy sea: the whale fireboat splits a huge wave in two with its water spout while the two on its back cling tightly to a ladder.
s1e08.c02: On the dark sea after the wave, fireflies are scattered everywhere; the firefly keeper holds onto his cap and looks around.
s1e08.c03: The baby penguin hugs his backpack tightly; light leaking from its opening grows brighter and brighter.
s1e08.c04: The baby penguin lifts the pebble high above his head; a bright golden light like a lighthouse shines across the sea.
s1e08.c05: The scattered fireflies fly toward the pebble's light and line up again; the road of light reconnects.
s1e08.c06: A small fishing boat between the waves: seagull sailors see the road of light and turn the wheel to follow.
s1e08.c07: The storm clouds part to reveal a green aurora, ice hills and an igloo village; the two jump with joy.
s1e08.c08: The whale reaches the ice pier; at the end of the pier stands the mother penguin in a rose-colored scarf, clutching a map.
s1e08.c09: Beside the mother penguin stand three small snowmen in a row as the third sun rises.
s1e08.c10: The baby penguin slides down the whale's tail like a slide and runs toward her.
s1e08.c11: The mother penguin counts the four sibling penguins one by one with her wing; the baby penguin pops into the fifth spot.
s1e08.c12: The mother's wing stops at the fifth one; tears well up in her eyes.
s1e08.c13: The mother penguin and the baby penguin hug tightly, the rose-colored scarf wrapping around them both.
s1e08.c14: The hamster courier pulls a parcel with three punched holes out of his cheek and holds it out; a rose scarf is drawn on the parcel.
s1e08.c15: The mother penguin opens the parcel; a small silver bell with a rose ribbon sparkles inside.
s1e08.c16: The mother looks back and forth between the bell and the hamster; dust puffs from the parcel and the hamster sweats nervously.
s1e08.c17: The mother penguin ties the bell onto the baby penguin's backpack and it jingles.
s1e08.c18: The mother penguin hugs the hamster with her wing too; the hamster's cheeks turn red.
s1e08.c19: That night inside the igloo, the baby penguin draws picture postcards with crayons.
s1e08.c20: At the pelican mailbox on the ice pier, the baby penguin drops in his postcards; the beak pouch is full of fish.
s1e08.c21: At the tiny snowy mountain station, the raccoon conductor receives a postcard and a fish drops out with it.
s1e08.c22: At the top of the lighthouse, the firefly receives a postcard; the fish that came with it is bigger than he is.
s1e08.c23: In front of the rock cave, the crab family holds up the postcard and claps their claws while the siblings drag away the fish.
s1e08.c24: In the cat chef's restaurant kitchen, he pins the postcard on the wall and grills the fish; his face stays the same but his tail wags.
s1e08.c25: On the ice pier, the hamster waves from the whale's back while the baby penguin, his mother and siblings wave back, the bell jingling.
